review_policy.qualification_alternative: Documented specialist experience approved by the study custodian

analysis_policy.endpoint: Adapt/Cover candidate proposals, including proposals stopped by factual confirmation; validated reports for other stages. Execution success and content availability are separate.
analysis_policy.agreement: raw pre-adjudication nominal Cohen kappa and observed agreement, per reviewer pair and dimension
analysis_policy.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals on primary case-level rates within each configuration/task slice; controls are descriptive
analysis_policy.denominator: Retain all preregistered observations; execution failures use attempted cases including unavailable providers, noncompletion uses all planned cases, semantic errors use available fully reviewed endpoint outputs including stopped proposals
analysis_policy.stop_rule: Fixed preregistered sample; no optional stopping or silent replacement of failures
analysis_policy.ordering: Serial execution in registered order; human reviewers blinded to configuration and each other's labels
